title: Robo360: A 3D Omnispective Multi-Material Robotic Manipulation Dataset
reasoning: The paper introduces a new robotic manipulation dataset and evaluates its effectiveness for 3D neural scene representation and multi-view policy learning. It does not contain any component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
